title: Man charged in connection to bomb threat at Illinois ethanol plant
summary_full: Andrew M Kozak, 41, pleaded not guilty to two charges in federal court after an explosive device was found at facilityA 41-year-old man has been charged in connection to last week’s bomb threat at an ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois.On Tuesday, the justice department charged Andrew M Kozak, 41, of Chillicothe, Illinois, with one count of transmitting a threat through interstate or foreign commerce to unlawfully damage or destroy the plant using fire and an explosive, as well as one count of making threatening interstate communications.
